headline: The hotel is the test
mechanism: AI Hospitality Group chose direct hotel management agreements with operating responsibility rather than licensing its technology to existing operators. The picture stages that choice as a brass hotel key whose teeth engage a teal cutaway of staffing, scheduling and guest service sectors, with a reception bell and workflow cards on a wire. It is conceptual and names no Texas property, because the dossier names no Texas pilot hotel.
silhouette: brass hotel key diagonal across a sectored teal cutaway disc, a domed reception bell at right, and workflow cards on a brass wire above

gaps_respected: No Texas pilot hotel is named or drawn; the empty plot marks that gap.
Operating claims are executive testimony, not audited results; nothing is depicted as achieved.

visual_review.findings: Inspected full-size cover and 300 px thumbnail. Final art shows a brass key, a sectored teal cutaway disc with staffing figures, a clock and hooks, a domed brass bell, and workflow cards; no located property is drawn.
